text:
alisa: Quick heads-up: we're targeting the SDK/docs/sample-app release this Friday 4pm PT. Need owners for: changelog cutoff (Thu EOD PT), sampleapp smoke, SDK lint pass, and embed regression tests. Can folks claim? @mike @jena?

mike: I can take SDK lint + merge blocker sweep. I'll run preflight today and push fixes by EOD.

jena: I'll own sampleapp smoke and quickstarts validation. Will run on Fri AM and report in this thread.

sam: I'll do changelog cutoff and final formatting. Please tag me with any user-facing changes by Thu 3pm.

patrick: I'm blocked on the embed vector test failing intermittently. CC @mike for potential SDK changes. CI logs:
```
embed_test.go:42: expected embedding size 512, got 0
error: nil pointer in encoder
```

mike: Looks like a race in encoder init, I have a WIP fix in PR #4281. @ci-bot can you run main + PR4281 together?

ci-bot: scheduled build for main + PR#4281. ETA ~12m. Logs will be posted here.

ci-bot: build passed: main+PR#4281 (linux, macos), tests: 1452 passed, 3 flaky ignored. Artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/4281/artifacts.zip

patrick: Confirmed embed tests green locally with PR4281. Will re-run full suite after merge.

mike: PR #4281 is ready for review. @alisa, can you do the changelog blurb for the encoder fix or should sam add it?

sam: I'll add a one-liner under 'bug fixes' and sync with marketing about user-facing note.

doc-bot: sampleapp smoke checklist created: /docs/sampleapp/smoke-checklist.md

jena: smoke run scheduled Fri 9:30am PT. Plan: clean env, run `./scripts/smoke.sh --quick`, validate readme steps, and run sample embeddings flow.

alisa: awesome — assigning owners here: SDK lint & PR sweep: mike; sampleapp smoke: jena; changelog & user messaging: sam; embed regression verification: patrick. I'll update release checklist and set changelog cutoff Thu EOD.

mike: pinging @eng-oncall in case the PR needs hot GPU infra; otherwise should be a small CL.

sam: note for release: add changelog tag `v0.9.3` and include migration note for new embedding init.

jena: will post smoke run results and short video if anything fails.

alisa: thanks all. If anything slips, call it out here and we'll decide go/no-go by Fri 1pm PT. :thumbsup:
